answer: Proof of Stake combined with a trellis of delegated reputation scores enforces Sybil resistance by anchoring identity to capital. An attacker must signal sufficient collateral to validate nodes, creating a high-cost barrier where each new identity acts as a wharf for locked assets. This economic weight makes the cost of proliferating fake identities prohibitively expensive, as every additional node requires proportional capital commitment that risks slashing if malicious behavior is detected during consensus rounds.
